answer: The mirror cap is policed at intake and karst shows the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool hence cannot mint a fleet in one epoch however much capital it holds, since each account consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. At most 2 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a wander tag. Each copy needs 7 hours of work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
